sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gladiator Doping - Part 2 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Let's keep looking at what can help you on the battlefield. There's a stimulant for every task. Try a different one this time, it's useful too, helps you deal with injuries. Hell, they're all useful... right up until an overdose catches up with you, ha!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 30 enemies while under the effect of the Propital stimulant

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
| Item name | Requirement | Notes |
| Propital regenerative stimulant injector | Required | Has to be active while making the kills |
